scientific_integrity: An analytical all-order proof and a finite exact arithmetic certificate are included; empirical checks are not infinite proofs; no outside independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Proved for four consecutive Fourier rows, N>=7 and exactly three distinct erasures; exact small-order bounds use a separately reproducible rational certificate. Earlier equivalent priority claims are possible; one related Fourier-SVD full text unavailable.
title: Three consecutive erasures are uniquely worst for four-row cyclic harmonic frames
